title: רב הונא בר ביזנא אמר רב שמעון
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Bizna reported Rav Shimon the Pious: Yevamot 60b; Ketubbot 67b; Sotah 36b. Rav Yosef said, “Rav Huna bar Bizna and all the great men of the generation …”: Sukkah 47a. See above, Rav Chana bar Bizna; it requires examination whether one is a scribal error.
